notes.title: The Front Page Vigilante Giveaway 📸
notes.content:
🗞️ THE SKELD SENTINEL
Galactic Edition #74 – Suspiciously Accurate 52.7% of the Time 100% of the Time

By B. Bowen Beaneson, Editor-in-Chief



For weeks now, the Vigilante has been on the loose and terrorizing beans across the cosmos. They may say it's "in the name of justice," but you and I know the truth! The Vigilante is no HERO, they're a MENACE!!!



So, dear readers, I'm turning my call to you.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/74318a975a0a6a99570376c6f66004ac23691754.png"]


📸 GET ME PICTURES OF THE VIGILANTE! 📸


That's right. It's about time SOMEONE exposed this violet vision of violence and I need visuals to prove it! That's where you come in.



We need YOUR photo submissions of the Vigilante — screenshots; video clips; heck, even artwork. Get these pictures to my desk ASAP by tagging @AmongUs3DGame on X.



Every other week until the end of July (June 27, July 11, July 25), four randomly-selected photos from your submissions will be selected to become a front page headliner photo - which should be prize in and of itself, but NO. Photographers these day expect more. Well, you want more? I'VE GOT MORE.



Winners will also be awarded with their very own DUM Duo Vigilante Cosmetic set: the Vigilante Hood and Vigilante Gloves. The interns tell me these are in high demand. Why? BEATS ME!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287672/e30439bf9964e4689ce8d7a4991b3f51d6c0c166.png"]
🚨 IN CONCLUSION:


Take pictures of the Vigilante

Get them to my desk through X

Become the front page photo of the Skeld Sentinel

Walk away with your own Vigilante Cosmetic set

EXPOSE THE MASKED MENACE ONCE AND FOR ALL!



And here's the fine print so hr gets off my back. Now go GET ME MY PICTURES!



–B. Bowen Beaneson, out.

notes.title: Break Out Your Cape 💥 DUM Justice Begins on May 29
notes.content:
Hey there, beans!

In just seven days, on May 29, 2025, our next Limited Time Event emerges from the shadows with a vengeance. Get ready to take justice into your own hands! 💥 It's time to suit up for DUM Justice!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/5418aafea9e41104b9bf9415f984e410fd21ec1a.png
DUM Justice brings the Vigilante role out of the shadows and into the arena. 🥊 Equipped with their own Kill ability, the Vigilante fights on Team Crewmate for love 💗, justice ⚖️, and vengeance ☠️. But, be warned — with great power comes great responsi-bean-ity! 🕸️ A Vigilante's Kill ability can be performed on ANY bean, Crewmate OR Impostor! 😱

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/b6526c69a2e22cd6b91c4a5193ca34bb4179ec58.gif

VR Crewmates may recognize the Vigilante role from last year. DUM Justice ran as a Limited Time Event back in the Among Us VR days, before the rebrand. ⌛ We've heard your requests to bring the role back, and so... we're answering the call and upping the ante. 😤

✨ The Vigilante permanently joins the role roster this time! ✨

That's right! While you'll be able to hop into our preset DUM Justice lobbies throughout this event, you'll also be able to customize your own lobbies and integrate the Vigilante role into them how you see fit. For good! (Or for evil. The choice is yours!) And you'll be able to add this role forever, long after this limited-time event ends.

💀 We're also upgrading the suit and releasing a new Vigilante cosmetic set — The Masked Zinger Bundle! Take on injustice with the Vigilante Mask: Year One hat, Digits of Doom gloves, and Caped Crewsader skin. And don't worry — your secret identity is safe, because wearing these items does not guarantee you the Vigilante role.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/2f822bda85fc60924ca2799704205938a988d928.png
Lastly, we want to take a moment to address the Impostor in the vent.

Alongside our upcoming content releases, we're working diligently on resolutions for performance issues, bug fixes, reviewing our moderation tools, and evaluating additional opportunities to help improve your experience in the game. Already under consideration are a number of improvements that we think will really help address your concerns. We are looking forward to being able to share more specific details for these updates soon.

It's important to us that you enjoy your time with Among Us 3D. So, we greatly appreciate the care and thought that you, our community, put into an experience that we all love. Our dev team is looking forward to continuing to refine, improve, and expand Among Us 3D.

💥 Suit up as Vigilante on May 29, 2025!

Stay suspicious,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png

notes.title: Among Us 3D: What a Launch Week! 🎉 + A Note on Voice Chat & Moderation
notes.content:
Wow. What an incredible few days since Among Us 3D launched on May 6! From the overwhelming support to the hilarious in-game moments you’ve shared, we’re so grateful to have such a passionate, creative, and chaotic crew with us. 💖

So let’s take a minute to celebrate what’s been going on, and also talk about a few things we know you’ve been asking about.

🚀 Community Highlights: You’ve Been Busy!

Streams That Made Us Laugh (and Cry Laughing)
#ICYMI, the TriHouse stream had us absolutely rolling. He was joined by Jojosolos, VR Central, and members of the Among Us 3D dev team to kick off launch day with a Steam store page stream. We don’t want to spoil anything, but let’s just say the betrayal was real—and loud.

[previewyoutube=4xgghmJDG3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Fan Art Galore 🎨
We’ve seen some wild and wonderful creations pop up already—including a gorgeous reimagining of the Among Us 3D Bean-lieve launch trailer that completely blew us away. Please keep sharing your art, videos, theories, and cosplay—we’re watching, and we’re loving it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/bd64d8ad66a07dbef574a988135744f592f2fd70.png
Credit: Shiba2mofu

Live from PAX: Crewmates in the Wild
If you’re at PAX East this weekend, members of the Among Us 3D team are hanging out at Schell Games booth #18109 so you can experience betrayal live from the show floor! We love connecting with fans and seeing the sheer panic that occurs when players round a corner to come face to face with The Infected. Play the game, meet the dev team, and purchase an exclusive Among Us 3D Pinny Arcade pin at our booth. You are the best Crewmates (and Impostors) we could ask for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/dab483a4a70b5200118bdb31e4a39ac6dfc52db9.jpg

🔧 About Voice Chat Moderation, Reports, and Safety

Okay—now let’s talk about something we know has been coming up a lot: voice chat moderation and bans.

First off, yes, we definitely see the feedback. Thank you for sharing your experiences. Moderation in a voice-heavy, social deduction game is complex, and we’re constantly fine-tuning what’s okay, what’s not, and how we respond. But that kind of nuance takes time.

Here’s what we want you to know:

We care about your safety. Moderation for any sort of multiplayer game - whether or chat or voice - has long existed. ToxMod, the service we use, is one you may have seen in other games like Rec Room or Call of Duty. It’s important to have something like this to ensure chat isn’t filled with harassment, hate speech, and other toxic behaviour. As far as moderation tools go, this is standard procedure!

No, we’re not selling your data (or voice). Period. The way most basic automated moderation tools work is to analyze the chat for toxic behaviour. (Which gets flagged and leads into our next bullet point.) This technology has been around for awhile, and this type of machine learning is not the same as generative AI. If you would like more information, you can view ToxMod’s privacy and data management here, or their full privacy policy here.

Context matters, and that's why we have a human moderation team. Although the moderation AI helps our team manage volume, it is not the sole, unchecked decision maker. We know the human touch is important.

Private lobbies aren’t exempt from the Code of Conduct. We get it—playing with friends is a different vibe, but we still want to ensure that everyone feels safe and respected in-game. Having private lobbies with no moderation also is a huge security issue, since unchecked online spaces can sometimes become unsafe.

We keep things consistent across all games. Our code of conduct has been with us for a long time, and one set of guidelines apply to Among Us, Among Us 3D, and Among Us 3D: VR.

This is an iterative process. We’re not perfect yet, but we’re listening and improving every day.

We’re trying to balance freedom and safety. Our goal is to let players be themselves without making others feel uncomfortable or unsafe.

If something doesn’t seem right or you think we missed the mark, please make a report or appeal a ban on the Among Us 3D player support site. Your feedback genuinely helps us land on the right answer.

🫶 Thanks for Being Here
We’re committed to making Among Us 3D the best experience it can be—for everyone. Whether you’ve been suspicious from day one or just hopped aboard the Skeld II, thank you for being part of this wild, spacefaring journey.

We can’t wait to see what you come up with next.

Stay suspicious, Beans!

notes.title: Start With Stardust 🌟 The Powered By Wishlists Giveaway

notes.title: Among Us 3D Infects PAX East 2025
notes.content:
The excitement is real, and PAX East will be here before you know it. As shipments of really neat stuff for our booth (#18109 mark it on your map now) continue to pour in, we thought it would be fun to reveal exactly what to expect from a visit to the Schell Games booth.

Here's what you can look forward to:

[previewyoutube=Uxnw01582Bk;full][/previewyoutube]
1) Play Among Us 3D
Uh, so there's a little game called Among Us 3D coming out on May 6, and we'd love to play it with you! We will have a handful of PCs AND VR headsets set up so you can play through a match or two of Among Us 3D all in one space with crossplay. Just be sure to get to our booth EARLY each day to sign up for a spot.

We'll be playing the all new Tag Mode. So be ready to solve tasks as quickly as possible and gain power ups if you're a Crewmate or to hunt down everyone and turn them into your slime-dripping allies if you're lucky enough to be The Infected.

2) Get the Game
Loved your demo? Snag Among Us 3D while you're here. We'll be selling game keys for Steam (20% off) all week right at our booth. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/e91464cbe2d6afb54f45fcffb96bcb1cc3afc4c2.png
3) Snag an Exclusive Pin
Listen, we can't give away ALL the details, but we were approved to at least show you the overall shape (WHAT COULD IT BE?!). Our booth will also be selling an exclusive Among Us 3D-themed Pinny Arcade pin. Once again, get here early to make sure you're proudly repping your pin for the rest of PAX and aren't hit with the dreaded "Sorry, sold out" game over screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/9a8e29668800d2008bbecd9f3b05115b4d13f5ff.jpg
4) Talk with our Devs
Demoing the game and getting pins is cool enough, but what we're most excited about is meeting all of you in person. Even better, we're bringing in some of the amazing people who helped make the game right to our PAX booth to meet with fans and answer all of your questions. Make plans to talk with Bryan G. (Advanced Producer) and Ryan H. (Senior Designer) who will be celebrating the released of Among Us 3D all PAX long and are pumped to answer your burning questions about Among Us 3D.

Share Your Photos and Videos
Loving your visit with Schell Games at PAX? Let us know. Share your photos and videos with us on social media. We'd love to see your best pic showing off your new Among Us 3D pin, takeaways from the demo or your favorite thing you learned from meeting with our Devs.

See you soon at PAX East. Stay suspicious!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png

To gear up for the onslaught of new beans hopping into the Skeld II, we're plotting our course for launch with some exciting potential stops — with future in-game reward unlocks — along the way!

Introducing the Powered By Wishlists Challenge! 🚀

notes.title: 🚀 Among Us 3D Launches May 6 ☄️
notes.content:
AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!

The launch date for Among Us 3D for Steam (PC) has finally been announced!

[previewyoutube=Uxnw01582Bk;full][/previewyoutube]
That's right! May 6, 2025 — less than one month away!

We've already given an extensive breakdown and FAQ on new and exciting features that will be coming to Among Us 3D... but, we can give a quick TL;DR here too:
 ✨💚 Tag Mode 💚✨
A permanent, new mode for Among Us 3D players that introduces another role: The Infected. Don’t let them touch you… Run, Crewmates, run!
 💬 Native Proximity Voice Chat 🗨️
Yap with friends directly in-game. No need for additional third-party platforms.
 ⏳ Limited Time Events ⌛
Experience new and experimental game modes, roles, and cosmetics rolling out for the rest of 2025. (Check out our 2025 Roadmap here!)
 💳 New and Returning Minigames 🎚️ 
Complete beloved tasks, along with some new ones. Now with mouse/keyboard and controller support!
 🎩 Customization Galore 👔
A wardrobe of hats, gloves, and skins present an endless number of cosmetic customization combinations. Purchase Stardust, Among Us 3D’s new in-game currency, to customize your bean.Reminder: Among Us 3D will allow you to play cross-platform with Among Us 3D players, even those in VR headsets. However, the game is not compatible with the original Among Us game on any platform. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/703dd4a69ac1c0b7ff9eaedc921c0083c0900ae9.png
To add to the excitement of launch, we're adding a challenge to your Task List:

Add Among Us 3D to your Steam Wishlist to help fuel the Skeld II and unlock exclusive, FREE in-game rewards after launch! Can we reach our ultimate reward destination?! 🔭

Learn more about the Powered by Wishlists Challenge here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/d46714f10e050134ae52a7a368fc80eff67d6923.jpg
We can't wait for the onslaught of new beans joining the crew on May 6th!

Stay suspicious,
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png
